verdict.rationale: Kick documents MCP, CLI and a gated Platform API that act on live workspace data, but the evidence never describes a sandbox or test environment isolated from production. The API reference's "Test it" runner sends real Bearer-token calls to use.kick.co, which is production rather than a sandbox. Approval prompts, period locks and separate entities are adjacent controls, not sandbox isolation, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
